h: VeryDarkMan gives Ogoja council chairman two weeks over water crisis
p: Activist VeryDarkMan has called out the chairman of Ogoja Local Government in Cross River State over a community's lack of clean water. He gave him two weeks to act.
body: Social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM) has called out the chairman of Ogoja Local Government Area in Cross River State, Christopher Agbeh, over a community's lack of clean water.

In a video message, VDM said it was unfortunate that in 2026 a whole community was still crying out for something as basic as water. He described the situation as disappointing and told the chairman he had two weeks to make himself useful to his people.
His comments have drawn attention to the lack of basic amenities in many Nigerian communities and renewed debate about the responsibilities of local governments.
No response from the Ogoja council chairman was included in the reports.
more: VDM says an Ogoja community lacks clean water.
He gave the council chairman two weeks.
